name: inbox.meta_claim
description: Claims an open message for a reply through our own Meta app, before it goes to Meta: the reply is kept as on its way (queued), so a second press or a second tab is refused. The message stays in the inbox until Meta answers (inbox.meta_done); a claim that never finished frees it after five minutes. Internal: packages/connect.
sql: update brandbase.inbox_messages m set reply_text = btrim(:text), reply_status = 'queued', replied_by = :actor, reply_at = :now::timestamptz where m.id = :id and m.brand_id = :brand and m.done_at is null and (m.reply_status is distinct from 'queued' or m.reply_at < :now::timestamptz - interval '5 minutes') returning jsonb_build_object('id', m.id) as result
